brief: Natural toothpaste and deodorant, you know the stuff. Just show it to whoever. Cheap, like $5 or so.

profile.business_summary: A budget-friendly brand selling natural personal care essentials, specifically toothpaste and deodorant, priced around $5.

relevant_tags.why: The advertiser explicitly describes their products as natural toothpaste and deodorant.
Personal care products like deodorant and oral care fall under the broader beauty and personal care category.
Consumers looking for natural toothpaste and deodorant are highly likely to seek non-toxic alternatives.
Toothpaste and deodorant are daily personal care essentials typically kept in the bathroom.
A low-cost, everyday essential is highly convenience-oriented.

persona_conflicts.evidence: "Natural toothpaste and deodorant, you know the stuff. Just show it to whoever."
"Natural toothpaste and deodorant, you know the stuff."

note_signals.why: A cheap ($5) daily essential is highly impulse-friendly and fits Swiftcart's convenience/grocery basket profile.

Marlowe & Co. attracts older affluent women with low impulse but high AOV, which clashes with a $5 basic item.

profile.gate_reason: The product type (natural toothpaste and deodorant) and budget price point ($5) are clear enough to map to relevant personal care, wellness, and grocery publishers.
